title: 第3章 简单任务(三)
content_zh:
2007年6月20日，这一天是三人永生难忘的一天，从这一天开始他们从以保卫祖国为己任的军人变成了人们眼中的败类，流氓。

“你们三个听明白了吗？”老将军坐在一张太师椅上，看着眼前站得笔直的三人问道。

三人相互看了一眼，唐峰开口道：“报告首长，情况我们已经了解，不知道我们的任务是什么？”

老将军摆摆手道：“别在叫我首长了，这里没外人叫我张爷爷吧。”顿了顿又说：“你们的任务很艰巨啊，国家需要你们将整个Z国地下势力统一在一起，建立一套完整的地下势力法则，使其不在危害国家，危害社会。以后有什么国家不好出面解决的事情也将由你们负责。”

三人听了大惊，开玩笑，靠我们三个统一Z国黑道？说笑呢吧？要是这么好干的话也轮不到我们了。

不待三人说话张将军又说：“我知道你们觉得有些难办，但你们要记住你们是军人，是Z国最优秀的军人，难道你们还会被一点点小小的困难难倒吗？我只想知道你们有没有信心完成任务？”

“有。”三人同时立正大声喊道只是似乎底气并不是很足。“不过”

张将军看着唐峰问：“不过什么？还有什么不明白的吗？”

“是，我想知道国家会不会给予我们帮助？”唐峰双眼直视着张将军道。这可是关键问题啊，要是没有国家的帮助要想建立自己的势力怕还有很长一段路要走，更别提统一Z国黑道了。

“你们想要什么帮助？我可以明确的告诉你们，国家不会给予你们太多的帮助，因为你们三个的行动是绝对保密的，除了你们三个和我还有小王外就只有一个人知道了，如果给予你们太多帮助那不是明摆着告诉别人你们是国家派来的吗？”看了看三人脸上的表情，张将军又说：“不过在某些方面还是可以给你们一些帮助的，比如说你们在抢占地盘的时候不小心砍死些小混混啊，或者是在不危害群众，不危害国家的情况下做出一些比较过分的事情，国家是不会为难你们的。”

听了张将军后面的话三人顿时感觉一松，也不像先前那么紧张了，他们不是怕混黑道，而是怕畏手畏脚，那样这个任务可就一点完成的可能性都没了，不过现在不一样了，有了政府这“准杀令”他们还用怕吗？他们最大的本事就是杀人，这看似可有可无的帮助却是三人最需要的。

“还有什么想问的吗？”张将军喝了口水淡淡的道。

“报告首张爷爷，没有了，我们保证完成任务，但不知我们要先从那里开始？”说话的依旧是唐峰。

“这个这个你们自己看着办，我不管你们从那里下手，我要的只是结果，还有，当你们走出这个门后，你们就是三个通缉犯，一会我会叫人把资料给你们，给你们三天时间你们将上面的东西全给我弄明白了，三天后我会叫人以杀人罪入狱，你们毕竟在部队生活了多年，没有一点黑社会的样子，送你们进监狱只是想让你们在监狱中从那些重犯身上了解一下黑社会，像他们多学习学习。”张将军说完在也不看三人，挥了挥手示意他们离开。

临时宿舍中，三人将手中的资料认认真真的看了一遍。

“峰哥，你，你觉得咱能成吗？”许强小声的问道。

唐峰看了许强一眼说：“有什么不行的？别忘了咱是干什么的，咱们怕过什么？没有，在咱们的字典里没有困难，没有难题。”

关智勇揉了揉双眼说：“峰哥，资料很详细，从资料上看Z国现在最大的4个帮派一个是雄距东北的狼社，一个是上海的洪帮，还有就是云南的黑虎会和香港的红星社，这4个帮派都是势力庞大不容易惹的主，直系小弟都有上万人，加上外围小弟有十万人之众，其中以上海的洪帮实力最强，这个帮派是个老帮派，以毒品为主，其他生意也有些不过并不是很多，他们老大叫田雄，外号雄一刀，道上的人都叫他雄爷，擅长用刀，今年56岁。其次是东北的狼社，这个帮派主要以军火为主，全国黑道80%的军火出自他们之手，据说他们和俄罗斯黑帮关系不浅，帮主和你一个姓，叫唐越，今年55岁是个厉害角色，当年一个人将整个东北黑道统一，道上的人都称他唐爷，很受人们尊敬，威望比田雄还要高。”

关智勇说道这里唐峰道：“这个唐越擅长什么？”

关智勇严肃的道：“根据资料上的情况来看，这个人貌似什么武器都用的很好，没什么特别的优点也没什么特别的缺点，非要说优点的话，那么就是狠，这个人当初曾今一人砍翻二十四个小混混，砍翻后将那些人全部碎尸，连5厘米以上的肉块都没有。”

听完关智勇的许强竟然流露出一丝恐惧的神情，而唐峰虽然表面平静但心中却也是骇然的紧，原以为自己已经够狠了，可跟这个唐越比起己以往引以为傲的战绩倒是善良之举了。

稳了稳情绪，唐峰说：“小勇，你继续。”

关智勇点点头继续说道：“排行第三的是香港的红星社，这个社团主要靠走私为主，老大叫陈浩南，为人极将义气，是无数小混混的崇拜对象，这个人还算比较爱国，虽说是黑社会但也没做过什么十分过分的事，此人十分擅长拉拢人心，这也是他以28岁的年纪就能当上老大的关键所在，这个人擅长徒手搏斗，按资料上所说的情况来看，这个人的搏斗技巧不下与峰哥，甚至，甚至有可能比峰哥还要厉害。最末的就是云南的黑虎会，资料显示这个帮会和日本樱花社关系不一般，生意以黄，赌，毒为主，虽然表面实力最弱，但有心人都知道这只是黑虎会比较会隐藏罢了。”

说完后关智勇抬起头看了看二人，接着道：“除了这些帮会外还有一些帮会实力也不弱，只是和这4个帮会比不在一个档次罢了，大部分都依附这些大帮会。要不是今天看了这份资料，打死我也不会相信Z国暗地里竟然这么乱，张将军说的对，这些地下势力是要好好的整合整合了，要不怕是不用别的国家来咱Z国也要四分五裂了。”

唐峰点了点头道：“是啊，这次的任务真的很艰巨啊。小勇，资料上有没有写这4个帮会之见的关系如何？”

关智勇笑了笑说：“说来也奇怪，这四个帮会之见都互相牵制着，除了黑虎会外其他三个帮会关系还算良好，而这个黑虎会却与洪帮和红星社关系都很紧张，两个帮会先后3次联合起来想要灭了黑虎会，但一直没能成功，直到现在Z国黑道还是四足鼎立的局势。”

“那依你看我们要从那里下手？”唐峰又问道。

关智勇像是早知道唐峰会这样问一般，清了清喉咙道：“我觉得我们还是先去西北发展的好，西北目前是最乱的地方，大大小小帮派数百个，却没有一个帮派能将其统一起来。西北比较穷，交通也不方便，在加上西北民族众多，各民族的生活习惯不一样不好管理，也没什么油水，所以到目前为止四大帮会并没有将触手伸到西北。”

唐峰思考了一会说：“那我们就先从西北开始，乱有乱的好处，乱了也就没人会注意到我们，我们也能更容易的发展势力。”说完后转头将还在愣神的许强拍了一下道：“小强，我们先去西北发展你有什么意见没有？”

“什么？哦，好，我，我随便，峰哥和勇哥决定就行了，我是个粗人。”许强缓过神来随意的说道。
content_en:
June 20, 2007, is a day that the three of them will never forget. From this day on, they changed from soldiers whose duty it was to defend the motherland to scum and hooligans in the eyes of people.

"Do you three understand?" the old general asked, sitting on a grand master's chair and looking at the three people standing upright in front of him.

The three of them looked at each other, and Tang Feng said: "Report to the leader, we already understand the situation, but don't know what our mission is?"

The old general waved his hands and said, "Stop calling me chief. No one here calls me Grandpa Zhang." He paused and said, "Your task is very arduous. The country needs you to unify the entire underground forces of country Z and establish a complete set of underground forces rules so that they will not endanger the country or society. In the future, you will be responsible for any things that the country cannot solve."

The three of them were shocked when they heard this and started joking. Do we need the three of us to unify the underworld in Country Z?Are you kidding me?If it's so easy, it won't be our turn.

Before the three of them could speak, General Zhang added, "I know you find it a little difficult, but you have to remember that you are soldiers, the best soldiers of country Z. Are you still stumped by a little difficulty? I just want to know if you have the confidence to complete the mission?"

"Yes." The three of them stood at attention and shouted loudly at the same time, but they didn't seem to be very confident."But"

General Zhang looked at Tang Feng and asked, "But what? Is there anything else you don't understand?"

"Yes, I want to know if the country will help us?" Tang Feng looked directly at General Zhang and said.This is a key issue. Without the help of the country, there will still be a long way to go to establish one's own power, let alone unify the underworld in Country Z.

"What help do you want? I can tell you clearly that the country will not give you much help, because the actions of the three of you are absolutely confidential. Only one person knows about it except you three, me and Xiao Wang. If we give you too much help, wouldn't it be obvious to others that you are sent by the country?"After looking at the expressions on the faces of the three people, General Zhang added: "However, I can still give you some help in some aspects. For example, if you accidentally kill some gangsters when you are grabbing land, or if you do some excessive things without endangering the people or the country, the country will not embarrass you."

After hearing General Zhang's words, the three of them suddenly felt relaxed, and they were not as nervous as before. They were not afraid of being involved in the underworld, but they were afraid of being intimidated. In that case, there would be no possibility of completing the task. But it is different now. With the government's "quasi-kill order", do they still need to be afraid?Their greatest skill is killing people, and this seemingly dispensable help is what the three of them need most.

"Is there anything else you want to ask?" General Zhang said calmly after taking a sip of water.

"Report to Grandpa Zhang, no more. We promise to complete the task, but I don't know where we should start first?" It was still Tang Feng who spoke.

"You can figure this out for yourself. I don't care where you start. All I want is the result. Also, when you walk out of this door, you will be three wanted criminals. I will ask someone to give you the information in a while. I will give you three days to understand all the above things. After three days, I willAsking people to go to jail for murder. After all, you have lived in the army for many years and don't look like a gangster at all.I just want you to learn about the gangsters from those felons in prison and learn more from them." General Zhang said without looking at the three of them and waved his hand for them to leave.

In the temporary dormitory, the three of them read the information in their hands carefully.

"Brother Feng, do you think we can do it?" Xu Qiang asked softly.

Tang Feng glanced at Xu Qiang and said, "What's wrong? Don't forget what we do. What are we afraid of? No, there are no difficulties or problems in our dictionary."

Guan Zhiyong rubbed his eyes and said: "Brother Feng, the information is very detailed. According to the information, the four largest gangs in country Z are the Wolf Society in the northeast, the Hong Gang in Shanghai, the Black Tiger Society in Yunnan and the Red Star Society in Hong Kong. These four gangsThe factions are powerful and difficult to offend. There are tens of thousands of direct followers, plus hundreds of thousands of outside followers. Among them, the Hong Gang in Shanghai is the strongest. This gang is an old gang, mainly engaged in drugs, and there are some other businesses.Many, their boss is named Tian Xiong, nicknamed Xiong Yida, and people on the road call him Xiong Ye. He is good at using knives. He is 56 years old this year.The second is the Wolf Club in the Northeast. This gang mainly produces arms. It is said that 80% of the arms of the national underworld come from them.They have a close relationship with the Russian gang. The gang leader has the same surname as you, Tang Yue. He is 55 years old and is a powerful figure. At that time, he unified the entire Northeast underworld by himself. People in the gang called him Tang Ye. He was very respected by people and his prestige was higher than Tian Xiong."

Guan Zhiyong said here Tang Feng said: "What is this Tang Yue good at?"

Guan Zhiyong said solemnly: "According to the information, this person seems to be very good at using all weapons. He has no special advantages or disadvantages. If I have to talk about advantages, then he is ruthless. This person once chopped down twenty-four gangsters by himself. After chopping them down, he chopped all of them into pieces, without even a piece of meat above 5 centimeters."

After listening to Guan Zhiyong, Xu Qiang actually showed a hint of fear, and although Tang Feng was calm on the surface, he was shocked and tense in his heart. He thought he had been cruel enough, but compared to Tang Yue, who was proud of his achievements in the past, this was a kind act.

After calming down, Tang Feng said: "Xiaoyong, you continue."

Guan Zhiyong nodded and continued: "The third one is the Red Star Society in Hong Kong. This society mainly relies on smuggling. The boss is called Chen Haonan. He is extremely loyal and is the idol of countless gangsters. This man is quite patriotic. Although he is a gangster, he has not done anything very excessive. This man is very good at winning people's hearts. This is the key to his being able to become the boss at the age of 28., this person is good at hand-to-hand combat. According to the information, this person's fighting skills are no less than Brother Feng, and may even be better than Brother Feng.The last one is the Black Tiger Society in Yunnan. The information shows that this gang has an unusual relationship with the Japanese Sakura Society. Its business is mainly pornography, gambling, and drugs.Although it is the weakest on the surface, anyone who cares knows that this is just the Black Tiger Society."

After finishing speaking, Guan Zhiyong raised his head and looked at the two of them, and continued: "In addition to these gangs, there are some gangs that are not weak in strength, but they are not at the same level as these four gangs. Most of them are dependent on these big gangs. If I hadn't read this information today, I would not have believed that country Z is so chaotic secretly. General Zhang is right, these underground forces need to be properly integrated, otherwise our country Z will be torn apart without other countries coming to it."

Tang Feng nodded and said: "Yes, this mission is really difficult. Xiaoyong, is it written in the information about the relationship between these four gangs?"

Guan Zhiyong smiled and said: "It's strange to say that these four gangs are all in check with each other. Except for the Black Tiger Club, the other three gangs have a good relationship, but this Black Tiger Club has very tense relations with the Hong Gang and the Red Star Club. The two gangs have joined forces three times to destroy the Black Tiger Club, but they have never succeeded. Until now, the underworld in Country Z is still a four-legged situation."

"So where do you think we should start?" Tang Feng asked again.

Guan Zhiyong seemed to have known that Tang Fengfeng would ask this question. He cleared his throat and said, "I think we should go to the northwest for development first. The northwest is currently the most chaotic place. There are hundreds of gangs, large and small, but no one gang can unify them. The northwest is relatively poor and the transportation is not convenient. In addition, there are many ethnic groups in the northwest. Each ethnic group has different living habits and is difficult to manage. There is not much oil and water, so so far the four major gangs have not extended their tentacles to the northwest."

Tang Feng thought for a while and said: "Then let's start from the northwest first. There are advantages to chaos. If there is chaos, no one will notice us, and it will be easier for us to develop our power." After finishing speaking, he turned around and patted Xu Qiang, who was still stunned, and said: "Xiao Qiang, let's go to the northwest for development first. Do you have any opinions?"

"What? Oh, okay, I, it's up to me. Brother Feng and Brother Yong can decide. I'm a rough guy." Xu Qiang calmed down and said casually.
